notes.conclusion: oZ is a capability gate, not a direct work/codex product-mode test. allowWork=true selects chatgpt.conversations; that access policy accepts either chatgpt product access or an allowed workCloud policy. The in_app_chat configFeature is still part of the capability contract.

true selects chatgpt.conversations and skips the seat-access loading/screen branches. Missing selected capability redirects /.
Both modes wrap allowed children in Suspense. Capability evaluator combines policy, statsig, settings and configFeature results; it is not a filename classifier.

notes.conclusion: sFs is the dedicated project-entry wrapper. Its final content branch uses oZ with default allowWork=false, but it can redirect to / with chatGptProjectId state before reaching that wrapper. This dedicated entry condition does not make shared project/settings components or local Codex project tasks equivalent to the ChatGPT chat mode or automatically excludable.
conditions: The actual vh registration at /g/:projectId/project has element sFs. sFs extracts the project identifier from pathname and reads LOCAL_PROJECTS, auth readiness, account-scoped local-project mappings, flag 2880010779, and gate 2929091547.
If no project ID exists, it returns null. With gate 2929091547 false and the linked-project flag enabled, it waits when auth is not ready or account scope exists but LOCAL_PROJECTS data is absent.

bu resolves to y7r; y7r uses x7r to find a local project paired through chatGptBacking with matching accountId/userId. x7r excludes IDs starting g-p- and accepts only a unique pairing for each ChatGPT project. It reads static project structures here; no real values were inspected.

With gate 2929091547 false and no mapped local project, sFs returns null while its same-gate signal s is true; otherwise it Navigate-replaces / with state {chatGptProjectId:projectId}. Gate true bypasses these mapping wait/redirect branches.
The final branch renders oZ({children:OJa({routeProjectId})}); allowWork is absent, therefore the existing oZ default chatgpt/seat-access capability branches apply.

Existing pss evidence contains sidebarProductMode===work, local Codex task creation, linked local projects and an independent settings-dialog call. Its project-open action also uses gate 2929091547 and preserves chatGptProjectId in a home navigation fallback. These cross-references are different from the dedicated sFs final-content gate.
